title: Antarctica Has a Lake of Lava That Fires Car-Sized Bombs

scenes.text: Antarctica has a lake of lava that fires car-sized bombs.
It is inside Mount Erebus, the southernmost active volcano on Earth.
The lake is about thirty metres wide, at roughly a thousand degrees Celsius.
Huge gas bubbles burst at the surface and throw molten rock onto the slopes.
Some of those lava bombs are as big as a car.
It has been churning since at least 1972, on the coldest continent on Earth.

description:
Mount Erebus in Antarctica holds a lake of molten lava about thirty metres wide, and some of the lava bombs it throws are as big as a car.
The lake has been active since at least the 1970s.
Would you visit it? Comment below.
first_comment: Fire in the coldest place on Earth. What is the strangest place you would want to visit?
